title: TJ Kidd and Tim Storey Join Forces on Instagram Live to Discuss the Second Annual 'The TJK Classic' for a Worthy Cause [Watch]
htmlContent:
In the spirit of giving back and empowering young women, TJ Kidd and renowned motivational speaker Tim Storey hopped on Instagram Live on Tuesday afternoon to discuss the highly anticipated second annual 'The TJK Classic.' The charity celebrity basketball game is set to take place on Saturday, August 19th, at 5:00 pm at Birmingham High School, located at 17000 Haynes St, Van Nuys. This exciting event aims to support The Ladylike Foundation, an organization dedicated to empowering and inspiring young women to reach their full potential.

TJ Kidd, the visionary behind 'The TJK Classic,' has a passion for sports and a heart for philanthropy. Being the son of NBA Hall of Famer Jason Kidd, basketball runs in his blood. But TJ has found a way to combine his love for the game with his desire to make a positive impact in his community.

The first 'TJK Classic,' held last year, was a resounding success, bringing together athletes, celebrities, and fans for an unforgettable day of basketball and philanthropy. With all proceeds going to The Ladylike Foundation, the event raised funds to support various programs aimed at empowering young women from underserved communities. These programs include mentorship initiatives, college preparation workshops, and career development opportunities.

Now, gearing up for the second edition of 'The TJK Classic,' TJ Kidd and Tim Storey joined forces to spread the word about this exceptional event and the incredible work being done by The Ladylike Foundation. Tim Storey, a globally recognized motivational speaker, and life coach, brings his uplifting energy and inspiring messages to support the cause.

During their Instagram Live session, TJ and Tim shared their excitement for the upcoming event, inviting fans, supporters, and anyone passionate about making a difference to join them on August 19th. They emphasized the importance of supporting young women in their journey towards achieving their dreams, emphasizing that empowering women uplifts entire communities.

'The TJK Classic' promises to be a star-studded affair, with notable athletes, celebrities, and influencers taking part in the basketball game. Beyond the on-court action, the event will feature fun activities, music, and opportunities to interact with some of the biggest names in sports and entertainment. But at its core, the event serves a higher purpose: to make a positive impact on the lives of young women by supporting The Ladylike Foundation's vital work.

Leah Pump founded the Ladylike Foundation, and since its inception, it has impacted the lives of countless young women, providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to overcome barriers and achieve success. By attending 'The TJK Classic,' participants and supporters contribute directly to these transformative programs, helping to create a brighter future for the next generation of leaders.

As the date of 'The TJK Classic' approaches, the excitement and anticipation continue to grow. TJ Kidd and Tim Storey's partnership on Instagram Live have undoubtedly ignited enthusiasm and generated awareness for the event. Their shared commitment to empowering young women serves as an inspiration to many, showcasing the potential for positive change when individuals and communities come together for a common cause.

So, mark your calendars for August 19th at 5:00 pm and join TJ Kidd, Tim Storey, and a host of talented individuals at Birmingham High School in Van Nuys for 'The TJK Classic.' Together, let's celebrate the power of sports, community, and philanthropy while supporting The Ladylike Foundation's mission to empower and inspire young women to reach their full potential. Let us come together to make a difference and create a lasting impact on the lives of these incredible young women.

Make sure you grab tickets for the second annual TJK Classic at Eventbrite.com.
